- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. ### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set of `submitBehavior.url`: unchanged — RIGHT. The whole diff is 34+/10- across `view.zod.ts` (two hunks, every changed line a ` * ` docblock line above `checkSubmitRedirectUrl`), the test file (header comment, lines 9–18) and one new changeset. No executable line, schema, key, type, export or `.describe()` string moved; the `url` superRefine and its describe (head `:4603`–`:4614`) and the `submitBehavior` describe are byte-identical to main. `Type Check · source gates`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset` green.

- Generated pages: cannot move — no describe changed; `Flag docs affected by code changes` and `Check Documentation Links` green; `Build Docs` path-skipped. `check:docs`/`check:generated` were run green by the dev; the CI family that re-runs them is in the check-run line below.
- Pin: `.objectui-sha` at the head and at `origin/main` is `20c6d351ad74b2b14a93becdc134d51b91b2d2e6`; the sentences were judged against that sha.
- New sentence "History, as it stood when #7496 was ruled: objectui's FormPage handed this value, as authored, to a browser-level navigation": TRUE as history — #7496 body says `FormPage.tsx:574` redirected verbatim; the pinned `FormPage.tsx:43`–`:44` header says the redirect "was consumed as a browser-level navigation on the authored string"; `submitRedirect.ts:81`–`:83` says the arm "handed it to the browser as a full-page navigation".
- New sentence "This paragraph records why the ruling was needed, not how any renderer behaves today": RIGHT — a scope marker, and the paragraph now makes no present-tense claim.
- Point 3 gloss "the destination is this string with its tokens substituted, and nothing else": TRUE at the pin — `submitRedirect.ts:239`–`:267` `resolveSubmitRedirect` returns the authored path with each `{{record.field}}` replaced by `encodeURIComponent(urlValue(record[field]))` (`:247`) and appends nothing; the pinned header `:18`–`:19` states the same sentence.
- New sentence "the navigation mechanism is each consumer's own, so nothing here names one": TRUE at the pin — Console `FormPage.tsx:2143` calls React Router `navigate(pendingRedirect)` (`useNavigate` at `:1947`) after `behavior.delayMs ?? 0` (`:2140`); `@object-ui/plugin-form` `submitRedirectNavigation.ts:108`–`:112` uses a host-injected navigate else `window.location.assign`, by an objectui maintainer ruling of 2026-08-17 recorded at `:20`–`:23`. Two consumers, two mechanisms; the ruling comment names none. Naming no mechanism satisfies the card's Done-when first arm.
- Test header gloss "(the destination, not a navigation mechanism)": RIGHT, same reading.
- Changeset body's Console description (substitutes, URL-escapes, navigates in-app through its router): TRUE at the pin (`submitRedirect.ts:247`, `FormPage.tsx:1947`/`:2143`). Its pin citation `20c6d351ad74` sits in `.changeset/*.md`, which `check:objectui-pin-citations` scans no further than `packages/spec/src` (its header `:76`), so it cannot red a later pin bump; it ships as a dated CHANGELOG fact — acceptable.
- Remaining present-tense mechanism claims in the two touched files: NONE. Grepped the head for window.location / assign / navigate / router / FormPage / browser-level / verbatim. `view.zod.ts:4596`–`:4601` ("this key must keep arriving at the renderer as the string the author wrote … what FormPage reads") and the test's `:264`–`:266` ("would break FormPage's read") describe the TYPE FormPage reads, true at the pin (`FormPage.tsx:2248` hands `behavior.url` to `resolveSubmitRedirect(url: string, …)`), and name no navigation mechanism. `:4608` "Where the browser goes" and `:4173` "navigates off-origin exactly like `//example.com`" are destination and URL-resolution facts, unchanged and not consumer mechanisms. `:2308`–`:2344`, `:3358`, `:4796` concern other keys.
- Ruling point 3 as the card quotes it ("a verbatim redirect on the resolved relative path IS the intended consumption"): still present verbatim and bold at head `:4090`–`:4091`, verbatim in the describe `:4613`, and quoted in the test heading `:247`. Only the clause after the dash changed. MATCHES.
- PR-body citations (`FormPage.tsx:2233`/`:2248`/`:2264`–`:2266`/`:2143`/`:2140`/`:1947`, `submitRedirect.ts:247`, `submitRedirectNavigation.ts:109`/`:112`, `forms.mdx:368`, `view.zod.ts:4613`, test `:247`/`:264`): every one verified at the pin or the head.

Green includes `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `Test Core` (6/6), `Type Check` (source, workspace, consumer, debt ledger), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (3/3), `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`.
